title: Hablar de lo que otros no hacen
communication_goal: Describir hábitos negativos de otras personas usando doesn't con he, she e it.
situation: Explicas la rutina de familiares y compañeros sin confundir la tercera persona.

dialogue.speaker: Luis
dialogue.english: No, he doesn't. He eats vegetables.

dialogue.speaker: Luis
dialogue.english: No, she doesn't. She walks to work.

explanation_es: Con he, she e it usamos doesn't = does not para negar. La estructura es sujeto + doesn't + verbo base: She doesn't drive. Aunque el sujeto sea tercera persona, la s desaparece del verbo porque ya está representada en does: He doesn't eat, no He doesn't eats.
spanish_speaker_notes: No digas She don't; con she usamos doesn't.
No mantengas la s en el verbo: doesn't likes es incorrecto; doesn't like es correcto.
La s de tercera persona aparece en does, no dos veces.
Diferencia sonido y escritura: doesn't termina con una consonante que conviene pronunciar con claridad.

pronunciation.tip_es: Graba primero lentamente y luego a velocidad conversacional; comprueba que doesn't no desaparezca.

reading.title: Lucía's healthy routine
reading.text: Lucía doesn't eat meat and she doesn't drink soda. She walks to work because she doesn't use a car. Her brother likes fast food, but he doesn't cook at home. Their dog doesn't need a car; it walks with Lucía.

activities.instruction: Clasifica las acciones según quién podría hacerlas en el contexto.
Escucha: No, she doesn't. She walks to work. Elige la pregunta.
activities.audio_text: No, she doesn't. She walks to work.
activities.feedback: La respuesta indica que no conduce y que camina.
Con he usamos doesn't para negar el presente simple.
Después de doesn't va eat, sin s.

activities.instruction: Corrige: He doesn't likes fast food.
activities.feedback: La s ya está en does; el verbo queda en forma base.

activities.instruction: Lee: She doesn't eat meat, but she walks to work.
activities.target: She doesn't eat meat, but she walks to work.

activities.instruction: Lee Lucía's Healthy Routine y responde: Why does Lucía walk to work?
activities.answer: Because she doesn't use a car.
activities.feedback: El texto conecta caminar con no usar automóvil.

activities.instruction: Describe a un familiar o amigo. La IA hace preguntas sobre lo que esa persona hace y no hace.
activities.scenario: You are describing a family member's routine to a curious classmate.
activities.ai_language: English; correct only the target error and keep the conversation moving

activities.instruction: Escribe seis frases sobre dos personas: tres con doesn't para cada una. Incluye una diferencia entre sus rutinas.
success_criteria: las frases son comprensibles y conectadas

describir hábitos negativos de dos personas
mastery_criteria.retry: Si escribes doesn't + verbo con s, elimina la s y recuerda que does ya marca la tercera persona.
